Links without title get empty title attribute when defaultTitle is true

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"default_title\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><a href='https://example.com'>Link</a></p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
